question: Who among the following became the first Indian to be invited to perform at the prestigious Lincoln Centre Hall in the United States of America?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bismillah Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Bismillah Khan became the first Indian to be invited to perform at the prestigious Lincoln Centre Hall in the United States of America.
 
• He also took part in the World Exposition in Montreal, the Cannes Art Festival, and in the Osaka Trade Fair.
 
• So well known did he become internationally that an auditorium in Teheran was named after him — Tahar Mosiquee Ustaad Bismillah Khan.
 
• National awards like the Padma Shri, the Padma Bhushan, and the Padma Vibhushan were conferred on him.
 
• In 2001, Ustad Bismillah Khan was awarded India’s highest civilian award, the Bharat Ratna. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **M.S. Subbulakshmi** was a renowned **Carnatic vocalist** and the first musician to be awarded the Bharat Ratna.
 
• She performed at several prestigious venues around the world including the United Nations General Assembly in 1966.
 
• **Zakir Hussain** and **Ravi Shankar **are also renowned Indian musicians who have performed at several prestigious venues around the world.
